name: IBGE SIDRA API

provider.name: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)

summary: Keyless URL-path API to the IBGE SIDRA tables: Brazilian inflation (IPCA), census, population, GDP, employment and agricultural statistics as JSON.
description: SIDRA is IBGE's database of aggregate statistics. The API builds a query from path parameters: table (t), territorial level and units (n), variables (v), periods (p), classifications (c), plus format (f) and header (h) switches. Responses are JSON arrays whose first element is a header row that names each column. Table 1737, for example, holds the monthly IPCA consumer price index.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented (the docs pages are behind a Cloudflare challenge and could not be fetched).

endpoints.summary: Values from a SIDRA table (path-encoded query; p/last 3 for latest periods)

example.response_excerpt: [{"NC":"Nível Territorial (Código)","NN":"Nível Territorial","MC":"Unidade de Medida (Código)","MN":"Unidade de Medida","V":"Valor","D1C":"Brasil (Código)","D1N":"Brasil","D2C":"Variável (Código)","D2N":"Variável","D3C":"Mês (Código)","D3N":"Mês"},{"NC":"1","NN":"Brasil","MC":"2","MN":"%","V":"0.07","D1C":"1","D1N":"Brasil","D2C":"63","D2N":"IPCA - Variação mensal","D3C":"202607","D3N":"julho 2026"},...]

coverage.geographic: Brazil, down to municipalities for many tables
coverage.temporal: Varies by table; table 1737 returned data up to September 2026

agent_notes: Docs and labels are in Portuguese. The first array element is a header row, not data; /h/n drops it and /f/c keeps codes only. V is a string ('...' or '-' mark missing data). Territorial level n1 is Brazil, n3 states, n6 municipalities (n6/3550308 is São Paulo city). Table and variable codes come from the SIDRA site.
caveats: The documentation pages (apisidra.ibge.gov.br/home/ajuda, sidra.ibge.gov.br) and servicodados.ibge.gov.br timed out or returned a Cloudflare challenge (403) from this sandbox, so parameter semantics were taken from observed responses only.
servicodados.ibge.gov.br (localidades, agregados APIs) was unreachable by curl on 2026-11-11 and is not part of this record.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key; /f/c, /h/n and a municipality query also answered 200.
